review_evidence: README states this is a Lean companion to Riehl's Category Theory in Context whose files reproduce definitions, theorems, examples and exercise statements from the text.

All six primary Lean files were inventoried; five section/appendix modules own about 108 declarations. Section_1_3.lean defines functors, contravariant functors and examples and proves functorial preservation properties.
The remaining CategoryTheoryInContextLean.lean is the project import root; no exact source-local subset was established as losslessly disposable.
summary: Retain the complete Category Theory in Context companion: its section files contain reusable categorical definitions, theorem statements and proofs, and the root remains navigation metadata.
